verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents model swapping and 'Dynamic Model Selection' and accepts a bring-your-own LLM API key. Community reports confirm it works with both local models and APIs, including GPT-4o, Ollama and Hugging Face, and lets users choose between open and closed models. However, the evidence never names most of the story's providers or shows switching scoped to individual agents or conversations. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Anthropic, Google and OpenRouter support, documented per-agent and per-conversation model switching, and detail beyond the one-line 'Dynamic Model Selection' heading.
